notes:
SUBTITLES NO LONGER RESTART THE VIDEO. Turning on a subtitle from a subtitle addon used to throw away everything the player had buffered and load the video again from where you were, so every pick came with a pause and a spinner. The subtitle is now loaded on its own and the video keeps playing. If a subtitle file cannot be loaded that way, the player falls back to the old method automatically.

THE SUBTITLE LIST IS READY WHEN YOU OPEN IT. Subtitles from your addons are now looked up in the background as soon as the video starts, instead of only when you first open the Subtitles menu.
